Alex — following up from Rishi's note with technical detail and a short mitigation plan. Key observations from initial traces:
- Spikes appear correlated with concurrent long-context streams combined with burst inference requests which increase queueing on the host.
- KV cache miss storms on hot prefixes amplified the tail; we've identified a hot-shard pattern.

Immediate mitigation (48–72 hours):
- Route Finvo traffic to a dedicated node pool with adjusted max-batch size (reduce p99 queuing).
- Enable conservative KV-prefetching and prefix-caching for high-frequency prefixes in your workload.
- Add a short client-side retry/backoff guide (we can provide snippet).

Pilot proposal (4 weeks):
- Dedicated capacity with reserved throughput (baseline capacity sized to your 95th percentile).
- Operational commitment: 99.95% region-level uptime and documented tail-latency thresholds (p99 < 350ms) for the pilot window, with runbook and two on-call contacts.
- Measurement: shared latency dashboards and weekly health syncs.

Estimated uplift (ballpark) — $12k–18k/mo depending on committed throughput and retention of KV-cache state across instances. We can firm numbers after a short sizing call.

If that sounds acceptable we'll prepare a formal pilot addendum and an internal change window to flip traffic.

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Head of Platform Reliability, Redwood Inference
